description: The image shows a wide, multi-lane roadway with marked crosswalk/turning markings but no visible continuous sidewalk or pedestrian path along either side; the curb edge appears flush with the road shoulder. Traffic is separated from the water by a metal guardrail, and the roadway is lit by tall streetlights, but there is little to no greenery or shade, and no visible curb ramps or other accessibility features. Pedestrian comfort/safety is limited by the lack of dedicated walking space and the open, fast-moving roadway environment.
